THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE J.M.KHAZI  ORAL ORDER
Both learned counsel for the petitioners and respondent No.2 as well as learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1/State are present.
2. Petitioner No.1/accused No.1 and respondent No.2/complainant are present.
3. A joint affidavit is filed duly signed by petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2.

The terms of the joint affidavit, reads as under:
"We, (1) Syed Naseer Ahmed s/o Syed Ashraf, aged about 33 years, residing at No.582, Court Road, Vinayaka Nagar, Doddaballapura, Bengaluru Rural District, Pin Code No.561203, and (2) Farhan Naz F. d/o Fathaulla Khan, aged about 31 years,
residing at behind: Naif Palace, Near E & NC: 2025:KHC:24718 HC-KAR T Hospital,
1st Main, Ring Road, Tumakuru do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as follows:
We submit that the aforesaid petition is filed by the Petitioners seeking quashing of complaint, FIR, Chargesheet, in C.C.No.10/2023 for the offences punishable under Sec. 498(A), 504, 506, 354, 494, 34 r/w Sec. 3 and 4 of D.P.Act, pending before the Hon'ble 2nd Addl. Senior Civil Judge & JMFC, Tumakuru, filed by the 2nd Respondent i.e., the 2nd among us.

entities.text: 2nd Addl. Senior Civil Judge & JMFC, Tumakuru

sentences.text: We state that the first among us and second among us were married on 21.04.2019.
Our marriage having been solemnized as per Islamic rites and customes at Star Convention Hall, Ring Road, Tumakuru.
We sate that we have settled all our differences amicably and we desire to withdraw/compound quash all proceedings filed by and against us.
We state that in view of amicable settlement between us, we desire that the proceedings in C.C.No.10/2023 pending on the file of the II Addl.
Senior
Civil Judge & JMFC, Tumakuru for the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 504, 506,

354, 494, 34 of IPC r/w Sec. 3 and 4 of D.P.Act, NC: 2025:KHC:24718 HC-KAR We state that the joint affidavit is executed out of our respective will and no elements of force or coercion are involved in executing this affidavit.
